Kira Kira Star Night.name: Kira-kira Star Night
Kira Kira Star Night.summary: Kira-kira Star Night is a homebrew indie game by Riki for the Nintendo Entertainment System and Windows. It has unique manga aesthetics and music.

Locksmith.name: Locksmith
Locksmith.summary: Unbelievable! Someone created the most complicated locks in the world. Captain Red-Hat Jack was assigned to grab the enemy's defense information centre's distribution plan, but firstly he must to resolve the series unbelievable locks to achieve his assignment. So time, intelligence, nervous and exciting will come with Jack always during the spy's war. Do you think he will finish this impossible mission? The answer is "you're better to help Jack!"

Money Game II, The - Kabutochou no Kisek.name: Wall Street Kid
Money Game II, The - Kabutochou no Kisek.summary: Where life, love and money all depend on how well you play the game. Make billions of dollars when you deal with the giants of Wall Street. Not only do you take risks by playing the stock market, but you must prove you can uphold a high standard of living. If you dream of fame and fortune, this Life Simulation game is your way to the top. You can taste the victory of success, but only if you're strong enough to face the challenge of life. Now, are you ready to deal?

Pinuocao de Fusu.name: Pǐnuòcáo de Fùsū
Pinuocao de Fusu.summary: Help young Pinocchio, as he travels the land to find medicine for his sick Father. Along his quest, he meets various characters, and discovers that his quest will be a whole lot more arduous than what he first though. It seems that an evil witch has overrun the land with darkness, and Pinocchio may be the only one able to stop him. If he succeeded, he could possibly gain the one thing he's always wanted... to be a real life boy!!!
